actions: Bind the two score-1 runs and selected media to exact controller, scorer, asset and replica hashes. The local source files were modified after both runs began.

Make the displayed and real turner consistent. The viewed demo sheet shows a slotted blade, while the README names a solid OXO blade and the rigid collision profile is declared solid. Verify actual blade thickness and under-cookie clearance.

Correct the turner-distance description or compute minimum distance to the blade and handle surfaces. Checking an axis line can pass a fingertip within 21 mm of a blade edge despite the published 50 mm clearance condition.

Distinguish breakage risk from measured breakage. Specify the PETG surrogate and its manipulation equivalence, including at least replica-to-pan, blade and rack friction checks with stated measured values or provisional limits. The README currently claims any grab, drop or upside-down landing breaks a real cookie.

Resolve runtime placeholders using one selected final artifact. Two existing success records ended at 1843 controls, 92.15 s at 20 Hz, with 1844 frames in the observed movie. Verify current hold and model/media packet before submission.
